newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT to split in two.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT to split in two.

text.p: Dutch post and telecoms group PTT Nederland (KPN) said on Tuesday it would separate its postal and telecommunications units.
Details on the split would be available in the second half of the year, KPN said in a statement.
PTT Nederland -- in which the Dutch government retains a minority stake -- said it aimed to implement the split in the spring of 1998.
"The division is a logical step in view of KPN's development over the past nine years," KPN said in a statement.

Since its partial privatisation in 1989, PTT Post had developed into a global player with annual sales of 13.5 billion guilders, while PTT Telecom's annual sales had reached 14.3 billion guilders, it said.
